title: Product Repository Markdown Boundary Completion Checklist

items.label: Capture product repository Markdown boundary inventory and owners.
items.evidenceTarget: Core, Backend, and Editor source commits, tracked Markdown counts, missing strict Authority Boundary counts, Work path, owner repositories, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, and Evidence target are identified before edits.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup, owner repos repo-core, repo-backend, repo-editor, and repo-project-control, active role documentation-synthesizer for product Markdown boundary completion and project-control-steward for Project Control records, phase target phase-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-product-markdown-boundary-completion, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-product-markdown-boundary-completion, and evidence target evidence-product-repo-markdown-boundary-completion-2026-09-01. items.verificationNote: RED evidence: Core npx vitest run tests/coreDocumentationAuthority.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed with 319 missing strict Authority Boundary files; Backend npx vitest run src/tests/backendDocumentationAuthority.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed with 38 missing files; Editor npx vitest run src/tests/editorDocumentationAuthority.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed with 54 missing files.
